## 4. Question 1 — the Wigner–Yanase–Dyson metric as a perspective: **yes, scoped as fiber instrumentation**, and one external fact makes it load-bearing

The corpus already owns the family-level results (homogeneity closure: peel = homothety ∘ totally-geodesic restriction, f ↦ f for *every* operator-monotone f; T2's radial-universality lemma). WYD adds nothing radially — I verified c_p(λ,λ) = 1/λ across the slice — and it must not be sold as a metric *selection*, which remains the named open floor (5-29 closing note). What it adds is a **coordinatized probe of exactly the sector where the family disagrees — the fiber — with structure the budget grammar already speaks**:

- **The decisive external fact (fetched and verified this session):** Gao–Li–Marvian–Rouzé, *Sufficient Statistic and Recoverability via Quantum Fisher Information* (Commun. Math. Phys., 2024): for a large class of monotone metrics **including the WYD skew informations, preservation under a channel characterizes sufficiency (Petz-recoverability) — and the SLD QFI is explicitly an exception** (preservation does *not* imply recoverability). For the transmission functor's conservation clause I.4 — what D↓ departicularizes is carried and recoverable, never locally readable — the natural theorem-home is precisely the sufficiency equality case, and the witness family for "transport is embedding-class ⟺ metric preserved" is therefore WYD-class, **not** the corpus's current SLD anchor. The purity-speed-limit/QFI-factor-4 layer keeps its flagship role; it just provably cannot serve as the embedding detector. This is the single strongest reason to introduce the family, and it fuses with Question 2 (§6).
- **The T2 sweep gets its canonical dial.** T2's queue item (2) — "Petz-f sweep of the fiber ledger; polarization exponent per f" — currently faces an infinite-dimensional family. The WYD slice is the principled one-parameter sweep: p ∈ (0, ½] after the p ↔ 1−p symmetry (verified symbolically — each WYD metric is self-symmetric, and the α ↔ −α duality lives at the divergence/connection level, the from-above/from-below pair in the corpus's own grammar), Kubo–Mori at the p→0 endpoint (verified limit), the self-dual Wigner–Yanase point at p = ½. Pre-registration shape: *radial exponent ½ family-universal (already forced); fiber exponent a measurable function of p, symmetric under p ↔ 1−p* — the symmetry is a free could-fail discipline on the probe itself.
- **The fiber ledger gets an operational currency.** Verified this session: g_p(i[ρ,K], ·) = (2/p(1−p))·I_p(ρ,K) — the WYD metric on commutator (fiber) directions *is* skew information, the information carried with respect to a conserved quantity the state fails to commute with (Lieb's concavity theorem is its convexity anchor). The T2 probe's "shape observable" (normalized commutator) is currently ad hoc; I_p is the principled replacement, with p as the sweep dial.
- **The rank-step gets a price dial.** f_p(0) = p(1−p) (verified): the whole interior family is *regular* — extends to the pure/rank-deficient boundary (Petz–Sudár), with the transverse fiber weight at a vanishing eigenvalue priced by 1/f(0). The KM endpoint (f(0) = 0) freezes the flag at the boundary; interior WYD crosses at finite toll 1/(p(1−p)), minimized at the self-dual point. Since the A12 Campbell gluing *is* a rank-step crossing at the boundary stratum, this is the natural mini-computation: **"the rank-step toll in metric p is 1/(p(1−p))"** — cheap, symbolic, could-fail, and it wires the WYD dial directly into the cross-rank story.
- **The affinity picture globalizes in exactly one member.** The corpus's radial identities live on the Hellinger sphere (affinity = sech λ). Among all monotone metrics, exactly one is a sphere pull-back with the classical construction — Wigner–Yanase, via ρ ↦ √ρ, with closed-form geodesics, geodesic distance, and curvatures (Gibilisco–Isola, J. Math. Phys. 2003: "the only monotone metric for which such an approach is possible"). If the T2 lock-vs-mix probe wants a fiber-inclusive "affinity-to-dual," Tr√ρ√σ is the unique member where that quantity has exact geodesic meaning.

**Liu-template grading, applied at birth:** public priority zero (Petz–Hasegawa, Gibilisco–Isola, Hansen, GLMR — all standard); content-distinctness = the wiring into the budget/seam grammar (the p-dial as the fiber axis of the scale/shape decomposition; the toll dial; the sufficiency-witness role); generative independence = open, priced at the two named tests (exponent-vs-p curve; rank-step toll). Counterweights kept honest: selection stays open — this is instrumentation, not ontology; and nothing here moves the forced-vs-chosen floor.

## 5. Question 2 — Campbell as intended: **yes; this is the right reading, and the lane is verifiably open**

First, the disambiguation the namespace now requires (three Campbells orbit this corpus): the proposal concerns **L. L. Campbell (1986)** — not G. A. Campbell of image parameters (Delta 8's nearest classical neighbor) and not J. E. Campbell of BCH, which appears nowhere in the corpus and is not in play. I fetched the 1986 paper (Proc. AMS 98) and confirmed what "as intended" means: Campbell works on the **positive cone** ℝ₊^m (explicitly because "the connection between geometry and probability is enhanced if the simplex is regarded as a surface in the cone"), his invariance class is **congruent embeddings by Markov mappings — cross-dimension refinements** (y_j = Σ x_i q_ij with q^(i) concentrated on partition blocks), and his theorem is that the invariant metrics are exactly **B(|x|)·(Fisher/Shahshahani) ⊕ A(|x|)·(rank-one mass form)** — two free functions of total mass, nothing else. The corpus holds the *decomposition* (Thread S: Eisenstein = the Campbell scale sector of the port-mass cone), the *gluing* (A12), and the *chain* (§G) — but grep confirms **no document uses the invariance-class-of-embeddings as the characterization device for the corpus's own cross-rank morphisms.** Stick-breaking *is* a congruent embedding; Kron conflation is its adjoint coarse-graining; the tower of ranks is exactly Campbell's setting. Three moves, ordered by cost:

- **P1 (note-sized, mostly assembled): the Campbell-closure companion.** Recast the homogeneity-closure results on the cone: un-normalized, the peel is *face restriction* — a congruent-embedding section — and the "post-selection, not CPTP" caveat dissolves, because the 1/u inflation is revealed as pure mass-sector bookkeeping (the artifact of insisting on the normalized slice), while the degree-(−1) homogeneity Lemma is precisely the infinitesimal form of Campbell's mass-sector invariance. Propositions A and B become corollaries of cone-invariance rather than observed properties of the peel. Could-fail check, symbolic and cheap: the budget sectors (x², u; capacity additivity) must transform under a q-split stick-breaking embedding exactly as Campbell's A/B sectors require.
- **P2 (the one genuinely new IOU, and it pays an old one): the quantum-Campbell slot.** Classify metrics on the un-normalized positive-operator cone invariant under sufficiency-preserving embeddings (isometric paddings V·V† ⊕ 0; equality-class channels per §4's GLMR result). Expected answer: Petz family ⊗ two mass functions — the quantum two-sector theorem. My literature pass found the classical cone case (Campbell; AJLS for general sample spaces) and the fixed-dimension quantum equality case (GLMR), but **no quantum cone classification** — a hostile lit pass should try to kill that absence-claim first, per the corpus's own sweep-first rule. If it survives: this is the missing information-geometric leg of OT5's IV.3 welding (Tannakian torsor rigidity + SU(1,1) homogeneous-space uniqueness + cone invariance ⇒ "the peel is the unique ⊗-compatible boundary reduction"), it is referee-able standalone, and it should *absorb* the standing OT5 formal write-up IOU rather than joining the queue beside it.
- **P3 (the Langlands-side discriminator, and the constructive augmentation with the present characterization):** Delta 9's flat-rate toll law is Campbell-shaped — C(stick-break K/ℚ) = log|d_K| is a displacement in the *mass sector*, object-independent by construction, exactly the signature of an embedding-class transfer under Campbell invariance (the two free functions depend on total mass only). Pre-register: **embedding-class transfers (induction/base change through the solvable cone) have flat-rate tolls; non-embedding functorial motions are object-priced** — which turns the already-named Sym²-toll test into the discriminating computation between Campbell-sector transport and genuine fiber transport, with a stake attached: if Sym² also turns out flat-rate, the embedding frame takes an erratum. The D↓/D↑ dualities slot in as the two halves of the invariance statement (D↑ isometric-onto-image = the embedding half; D↓ DPI-contraction = the coarse-graining half; the conservation clause = the Petz-recoverable complement, which is where §4's equality-case theorem lives).

**Liu-template grading:** priority zero on every classification ingredient (Campbell 1986; Chentsov; Petz; GLMR); distinctness = the identification of the I.2 morphisms as the congruent-embedding class, the flat-vs-object-priced toll discriminator, and the cone-dissolution of the post-selection caveat; generativity = P2's theorem if the absence survives, and P3's pre-registered stake either way. One caution: Campbell's theorem quantifies over the *full family* of split parameters, as Chentsov's does — the characterization is of invariance under all stick-breakings, not any single one; the write-up should say so to keep the uniqueness honest.

## 6. Where the two questions fuse

They are one question at the seam. Campbell-as-embedding (Q2) characterizes *which cross-rank motions are structure-preserving*; the sufficiency equality case says *metric preservation detects exactly those motions* — and the metrics for which that detection is a theorem are the WYD class (Q1), not SLD. The rank-step toll 1/(p(1−p)) prices the crossing that the A12 gluing describes, on the dial the WYD family provides. Concretely, the fused pre-registration: *along an embedding-class transfer, WYD-metric displacement is confined to the mass sector (flat-rate, object-independent); along a non-embedding transfer, fiber displacement appears and is skew-information-valued.* Every ingredient is standard; the sentence is the framework's; and it is falsifiable at both ends (Sym²-toll arithmetic side; Petz-f sweep quantum side).
